# dataiku_projects (Data Source)

Lists every Dataiku DSS project the API key is allowed to read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataiku_projects" "all" {}

output "project_keys" {
  value = data.dataiku_projects.all.project_keys
}

# Apply the same standard variables to every project on the instance.
resource "dataiku_project_variables" "shared" {
  for_each = toset(data.dataiku_projects.all.project_keys)

  project_key = each.value
  standard    = jsonencode({ managed_by = "terraform" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The instance URL the projects were read from.
- `project_keys` (List of String) Keys of all readable projects, convenient for `for_each`.
- `projects` (Attributes List) One entry per readable project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Long description of the project.
- `name` (String) Display name of the project.
- `owner` (String) Login of the project owner.
- `project_key` (String) Key of the project.
- `short_desc` (String) Short description of the project.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the project.
